# Store migration fixtures

`store-v3.db` was generated from the unchanged v3 source at
`c296625498d20edcccb7fc7ebd83a8226e16ad82` using the store APIs and the
existing `support::world` fixture. It contains an active tracked workspace,
a Pending proposal, an adopted replay target, and an Auto move activity row.

To reproduce in an isolated checkout of that commit, copy
`generate_v3_fixture.rs.txt` to `tests/generate_v3_fixture.rs`, then run:

```
CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$PWD/target RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache cargo test -p strata-store --test generate_v3_fixture -- --ignored
```

The helper checks schema version 3 and refuses to overwrite an existing file.
It closes the store before copying its standalone SQLite database, so no WAL
sidecars are required. Its source is retained as text because it intentionally
uses the pre-v4 API.

`store-v5.db` is an empty v5 schema generated by executing the frozen BASE_DDL
and migrations through v5 from ae24d38 with the pinned Turso engine, then a
TRUNCATE WAL checkpoint. The v6 migration test verifies its backup and exact
fresh/migrated schema equality. It contains no live data.

`store-v7-turso-pre1.db` is a populated v7 store written by the 0.2.1
engine (turso `=0.9.0-pre.1`) at `9e51100`: the `support::world` fixture,
one Pending proposal and a Done mark. `tests/turso_pre1_v7.rs` opens it on
the current engine and checks that the schema rows equal a fresh store's,
that the rows read back, and that a write keeps both true. To reproduce, in
an isolated checkout of `9e51100` copy `generate_v7_fixture.rs.txt` to
`tests/generate_v7_fixture.rs` and run:

```
env -u TMPDIR cargo test --locked -p strata-store --test generate_v7_fixture -- --ignored
```

The helper checks schema version 7 and refuses to overwrite an existing file.
